x: "A Southern Counties 6-Stage Relay was held from Belgrave Hall on April 4th over a four and three-quarter miles lap. Belgrave were winners with Marchant, Patience, Shields, Penny, Cohen and Carter.
The Captain that day was Bert Footer and the rest of the team were Allum, Carter, Flower, Ginty, Parker, Patience; Shaw, Ring, Rice, Shields and Taylor.
